name: minGPT adder
notes: Rebuilt with zero changes to upstream source. gpt-nano (0.09M params) trained from scratch to add two 2-digit numbers: 99.2% on the held-out test split in 195s on one T4 — and 2m22s on 4 CPU cores, so no GPU is needed. No dataset to fetch: AdditionDataset synthesises every problem in-process from a seeded RNG. Two real upstream gaps: setup.py declares only torch but mingpt/utils.py imports numpy, so a clean install per the README fails to import; and the demo has no stopping criterion at all (Trainer.max_iters defaults to None, so it trains forever) and publishes no target accuracy, so max_iters=3000 is the operator's choice, not upstream's.
